  keyName                           — name of the key to create
  diskEncryptionSetName             — name of the DiskEncryptionSet to create
  confidentialVMOSDiskEncryption    — when true, uses ConfidentialVmEncryptedWithCustomerKey DES type
                                      and grants CVM Orchestrator the Crypto Release User role
  confidentialVMOrchestratorObjectId — required when confidentialVMOSDiskEncryption is true;
                                       object ID of the Confidential VM Orchestrator
                                       enterprise application (bf7b6499-ff71-4aa2-97a4-f372087be7f0)
  skipKeyCreation                   — when true, skips key creation (key was pre-created via
                                      Run Command or external process due to key release policy
                                      immutability). Used by hostpool Run Command path.
                                      When false/omitted, key is created via ARM with release policy.
                                      WARNING: ARM key creation with keyReleasePolicy is a one-time
                                      operation — the policy is immutable. Re-deploying will fail if
                                      the key already exists. Use skipKeyCreation on subsequent deploys.

displayName.value: Configure automated AVD session host OS disks with a Disk Encryption Set

description.value: Assigns the created or selected Disk Encryption Set to Windows session host OS disks during VM creation or update.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host OS disk must use the Disk Encryption Set selected for this host pool.

displayName.value: Configure automated AVD session host compute security settings

description.value: Enforces encryption at host and the selected OS disk size during VM creation or update.

nonComplianceMessage.value: Session host virtual machines must use the selected encryption-at-host and OS disk settings.

displayName.value: Configure accelerated networking on automated AVD session hosts

description.value: Enforces the selected accelerated-networking setting on network interfaces in the dedicated session host resource group.

nonComplianceMessage.value: Session host network interfaces must use the selected accelerated-networking setting.

displayName.value: Inherit the automated AVD host pool ownership tag

description.value: Copies cm-resource-parent from the dedicated session host resource group to service-created virtual machines, network interfaces, and managed disks.

nonComplianceMessage.value: Session host resources must inherit the cm-resource-parent tag from their resource group.

displayName.value: Configure automated AVD session hosts with system-assigned managed identity

description.value: Enables system-assigned managed identity on session host virtual machines while preserving any user-assigned identities.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must have a system-assigned managed identity for Azure Monitor Agent authentication.

displayName.value: Deploy Azure Monitor Agent to automated AVD session hosts

description.value: Uses the Microsoft built-in policy to deploy Azure Monitor Agent with each VM system-assigned identity.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must run Azure Monitor Agent using its system-assigned managed identity.

displayName.value: Associate automated AVD session hosts with a Data Collection Rule

description.value: Uses the Microsoft built-in policy to associate each session host with the selected Data Collection Rule.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must be associated with the selected Data Collection Rule.

displayName.value: Associate automated AVD session hosts with a Data Collection Endpoint

description.value: Uses the Microsoft built-in DCR or DCE association policy in Data Collection Endpoint mode.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must be associated with the selected Data Collection Endpoint.

displayName.value: Disable public network access on automated AVD session host managed disks

description.value: Disables public network access and denies all network export access on managed disks.

nonComplianceMessage.value: Session host managed disks must disable public network access and deny all network export access.

displayName.value: Deploy Guest Attestation on automated AVD session hosts

description.value: Deploys Guest Attestation to Trusted Launch and Confidential VM session hosts for boot integrity monitoring.

nonComplianceMessage.value: Trusted Launch and Confidential VM session hosts must run the Guest Attestation extension.

description.value: Configures the time zone, enables time zone redirection, optionally configures FSLogix, and expands the OS partition.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must have successfully completed the FederalAVD session host configuration.

displayName.value: Run ordered private customizations on automated AVD session hosts

description.value: Preserves existing VM identities, attaches the artifact identity, and runs private customizations in the supplied order.

nonComplianceMessage.value: The session host must have successfully completed the ordered private customization sequence.
